kind: Node VM model, command and customer adapter checks; no native browser

results.name: Retained source CSS, branding and customer data are used verbatim
All five staff views render and customer iframe uses exact retained bytes
Default r03 amounts reconcile without repricing the source
Permitted options change exact totals; unknown, duplicate and missing alternatives fail
Wrong hash, revision, customer, amount, signature and consent block acceptance
Unknown response retains original identity and blocks duplicate and retry
Reconciliation to failure permits retry of the same captured request only
Acceptance handover is explicit and cannot convert or duplicate an order
Supersession retains the response but holds any prepared handover
Fresh issue-session state has no inherited signature, response, consent or handover
Clarification pauses acceptance until an information-only answer is confirmed
Material change routes to ES-05 and cannot be resolved as unchanged afterwards
A declined issue keeps its reason and blocks acceptance and conversion
Expiry and withdrawal hold new responses at the command boundary
Late reconciliation retains old issue evidence without reopening expired issue
Saved response reloads; altered amount, identity and receipt fail validation
Interrupted pending operation recovers to Unknown, requiring reconciliation
Read-only role blocks staff changes and response submission
Iframe messages require the actual frame and matching issue hash
Valid frame response persists before a saved receipt context is supplied
Cross-tab changes hold writes and remove active customer response permission
Corrupt storage is retained and visibly held for recovery
Storage failure withholds acceptance receipt and further mutation
Typed customer acceptance adapter retains r03 validation and sends exact signature payload
